name: Westlake Village Community Foundation Board Meeting
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the
  Westlake Village Community Foundation

  Westlake Village City Hall
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  City Hall Conference Room
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  Tuesday, April 22, 2025 - 12:00 p.m.

Written Public Comments may be sent to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later
than 9:00 a.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to the Committee.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the Committee Members less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are
available for public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during
normal business hours and are posted on the City’s Website: www.wlv.org/foundation

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas
 or www.wlv.org/agendacenter or https://www.wlv.org/AgendaCenter/Westlake-Village-
 Community-Foundation-12

 Signup for Agenda Posting Notifications for the Agenda Center. The Agenda Center is a
 central location for all public meeting agendas. You select the categories for your notifications.
 Sign up using “Notify Me” on the Westlake Village home page or https://www.wlv.org/List.aspx
 CALL TO ORDER:  12:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Foundation Board Members Brutzkus, Croner, Halpern, Vice
  Chair Honig and Chair McSweeney

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the Westlake Village Community Foundation Board Members on items
not on this printed agenda by attending this in-person meeting or by email comments as outlined on Page
1 of the agenda.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Approval of the November 19, 2024 Minutes.

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

1.  Election of Chairperson and Vice Chairperson – Annual Reorganization and
  update of banking authorities, if required.

2.  Financial Update – Receive Financial Report.

3.  2025 Scholarships

  a. Selection of Awardees and Amounts for the Foundation’s 2025
  Scholarship Program.

  b. Selection of Board Member to Present Scholarship at Senior Awards
  Night events.

4.  Receive Sponsorships and Grant Funds for the 2025 City of Westlake Village
  4th of July Fireworks Event

  a. Receive $10,000 Sponsorship from Oltmans Construction Company and
  Approve Expenditure for City of Westlake Village July 4th City Fireworks
  Event.

  b. Anticipated receipt of a Grant from the Gene Haas Foundation and
  Approve Expenditure for City of Westlake Village July 4th City Fireworks
  Event.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, April 17, 2025 at 6:15 pm. on the City website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  April 17, 2025
